record.original_question: Let k be a field of characteristic zero. Is the group GAn(k) generated by tame automorphisms together with finitely many one-parameter subgroups of automorphisms?

evidence.quote: Problem 2. Is it true that GAn(k) (k a field of char. zero) is generated by tame automorphisms and finitely many one-parameter subgroups of automorphisms?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic zero, and for an integer $n \geq 1$ let $\mathrm{GA}_n(k) = \mathrm{Aut}_k(k[x_1,\ldots,x_n])$ denote the group of polynomial automorphisms of affine $n$-space over $k$; equivalently, $\mathrm{GA}_n(k)$ consists of all $k$-algebra automorphisms $\varphi$ of $k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, identified with $n$-tuples $(\varphi(x_1),\ldots,\varphi(x_n))$ of polynomials whose Jacobian determinant is a nonzero element of $k$. 

Within $\mathrm{GA}_n(k)$, the subgroup of tame automorphisms $\mathrm{TA}_n(k)$ is the subgroup generated by the affine linear automorphisms (the group $\mathrm{Aff}_n(k) = \mathrm{GL}_n(k) \ltimes k^n$) together with the elementary (triangular) automorphisms of the form $(x_1,\ldots,x_{i-1}, x_i + f(x_1,\ldots,\hat{x_i},\ldots,x_n), x_{i+1},\ldots,x_n)$ for $f \in k[x_1,\ldots,\hat{x_i},\ldots,x_n]$.

A one-parameter subgroup of $\mathrm{GA}_n(k)$ is a group homomorphism $\rho: (k,+) \to \mathrm{GA}_n(k)$ such that the map $k \times k^n \to k^n$, $(t, x) \mapsto \rho(t)(x)$, is polynomial in $t$ and in $x$.

Question: Does there exist a finite collection $\rho_1, \ldots, \rho_m$ of one-parameter subgroups of $\mathrm{GA}_n(k)$ such that $\mathrm{GA}_n(k)$ is generated, as an abstract group, by $\mathrm{TA}_n(k)$ together with the images of $\rho_1, \ldots, \rho_m$?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution was located. The question of generating the polynomial automorphism group $\mathrm{GA}_n(k)$ in characteristic zero by tame automorphisms together with finitely many one-parameter subgroups appears to remain open; for $n=3$ it is known (Shestakov–Umirbaev) that wild automorphisms exist, so $\mathrm{GA}_n(k) \neq \mathrm{TA}_n(k)$ in general, but no result establishing or refuting generation modulo finitely many one-parameter subgroups was found.

status_evidence.title: Automorphism groups of affine varieties and ind-groups
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses structure of GA_n(k), tame subgroup, and ind-group structure with one-parameter subgroups, without resolving generation by tame plus finitely many one-parameter subgroups.
status_evidence.claim: The structure of GA_n(k) as an ind-group and its tame subgroup are actively studied, but the specific generation question is not reported as resolved.

status_evidence.title: On the variety of automorphisms of the affine plane (Furter)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the ind-variety structure of the automorphism group of the affine plane and its one-parameter subgroups.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on one-parameter subgroups of polynomial automorphism groups exists but does not settle the stated question for general n.
